disposition_definition: pass means bounded candidate disposition only, never user approval. needs-decision may indicate incomplete evidence rather than defective art.
blocker: vision_analyze returned HTTP 402 insufficient_balance_error. Four boards were successfully inspected before exhaustion. Burkina Faso board failed twice; all four Angola original PNGs and its marketing.webp failed. Remaining originals were not attempted after persistent provider failure. Board thumbnails do not substitute for required original-image inspection.
